text: Added the `claude_code.safety_event` OpenTelemetry event for each tool call
Improved auto mode with the server-side classifier: a conversation too long for the safety check is now compacted
Fixed features missing from Claude Code sessions in the Claude desktop app when the terminal on the same computer was signed in to a different account
Fixed Grep and Glob reporting no matches when the search program failed unexpectedly
Fixed hooks that run in PowerShell not blocking when the hook's program exits with code 2
Windows: Fixed PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks letting a tool call through when Git Bash is missing
Fixed `/permissions` > Recently denied not showing the denied shell command
